blocks.text: 1.1. The policy covers fire, explosion and burglary. Water damage and natural events are covered only if stated in the Schedule.
2.1. The Insurer does not pay for war and military actions, gradual damage and wear, unauthorised construction, or losses while the home is vacant for more than 30 days.
3.1. The sum insured is USD 60,000, with a contents sublimit of USD 8,000.
4.1. The deductible is 10% of each loss.
4.2. Losses are paid at market value after deducting depreciation of 15% per year of age of the item.
5.1. The Insurer pays within 30 days after receiving all documents.
6.1. The Policyholder must notify the Insurer within 24 hours of discovering the loss.
7.1. The Policyholder must keep an alarm connected to a security service and certified locks on all external doors.
8.1. The premium is EUR 210 per year. No refund is made on early termination.
9.1. The Insurer may recover paid amounts from the Policyholder if the Policyholder breached any obligation of this policy.
